title: Trace European Soil Evidence lower readers
changes: Capture instruction-scoped source sites for the 193 previously unowned lower words observed in Soil Evidence, retaining exact opcode and source-hash evidence.
validation: Wine unit e264-soil-lower-sites-wine-bdta3t36 observes all 193 words across 600 E232 frames; 135 distinct words have matching original PC-relative Thumb literal-load witnesses. Of 203 selected reads, 182 have an instruction scope and 21 do not.
limitations: Interpreter scopes may contain nested accesses; this observation publishes no owner and does not prove every caller, full source extent or scene equivalence. The other 58 lower words and the upper residual remain open.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. Wine drained with the local Bluetooth overlay; no performance comparison was performed.
